create.title: Create a tenant
create.subtitle: A tenant is your workspace: library, runs, members and cloud profiles.
create.firstBody: You are not a member of any tenant yet. Create your own — it takes a few seconds — or wait for an invite.
create.ownedBody: You already own {{name}}. You can be a member of any number of other tenants, but only one can be yours.
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Becomes part of URLs and API paths; cannot be changed later.
create.whatHappens: Creating a tenant provisions a Graphene namespace and pushes the pipelines; you become its owner.
